primitives.name: Godot Engine 4.7.2 (standard or .NET)
primitives.install: Download the 4.7.2-stable editor for your OS from https://godotengine.org/download/ and put it on PATH as godot (CI: same version from https://github.com/godotengine/godot/releases)

primitives.name: Godot export templates 4.7.2
primitives.install: Editor > Manage Export Templates > Download and Install (must match the editor version exactly)

primitives.name: Godot MCP (Coding-Solo/godot-mcp)
primitives.install: claude mcp add godot -e GODOT_PATH=/path/to/godot -- npx @coding-solo/godot-mcp@0.1.1

primitives.name: GUT (Godot Unit Test) 9.7.1
primitives.install: AssetLib: GUT 9.7.1 for Godot 4.7.x, then enable in Project Settings > Plugins; or copy addons/gut from the v9.7.1 release

primitives.name: gdUnit4 v6.2.x
primitives.install: AssetLib: gdUnit4, or copy addons/gdUnit4 from the release matching your Godot version (v6.2.x: Godot 4.5 to 4.7.1; master v7.0.0: 4.7 and 4.8 dev)

primitives.name: wshobson/agents (godot-gdscript-patterns skill)
primitives.install: /plugin marketplace add wshobson/agents, then /plugin install game-development@agents (the plugin holding the godot-gdscript-patterns skill)

primitives.name: OpenJDK 17 and Android SDK (Platform 35, Build-Tools 35.0.1, NDK r28b)
